related_questions.question: How much downpayment is needed for a commercial loan?
related_questions.snippet: The minimum amount down for a commercial property is largely dictated by the type of loan: Bank loans typically require a down payment of 20% to 30%. SBA 7(a) loans require a down payment of 10% to 20%. SBA 504 loans require a down payment of 10% to 15%.

related_questions.question: What US banks offer international mortgages?

text_blocks.snippet: While most US banks don't offer international mortgages, some specialize in providing them to US expats and foreign nationals. HSBC, Citibank, and America Mortgages are notable options. Additionally, Barclays International and Standard Chartered International may be viable for those with existing relationships or specific geographic needs.

list.title: HSBC:
list.snippet: Offers mortgages for US citizens buying property abroad, as well as mortgages for foreign nationals purchasing property in the US. HSBC also provides support for international property searches and related services.

list.title: Citibank:
list.snippet: Known for its international banking network, Citibank may offer mortgages for various purposes, including holiday homes, investment properties, or buy-to-let properties.

list.title: America Mortgages:
list.snippet: Specializes in mortgages for US expats and foreign nationals, providing solutions for purchasing, refinancing, or releasing equity on overseas properties. They offer conforming loans to US expats, even if their income is earned overseas.

list.title: Other Options:
list.snippet: Barclays International and Standard Chartered International may also be suitable for certain individuals, particularly those with existing banking relationships or specific country requirements.

list.title: Not all US banks offer international mortgages:
list.snippet: Research specific lenders and their offerings, as not all banks provide these services.

list.title: Geographic limitations:
list.snippet: Some lenders may have restrictions on the countries where they offer mortgages.

list.title: Expat-specific products:
list.snippet: Banks like America Mortgages cater to US expats with loans designed for their unique situations.

list.title: Foreign national mortgages:
list.snippet: Lenders such as America Mortgages offer mortgages to foreign nationals purchasing property in the US.

list.title: Consult with a professional:
list.snippet: Seek guidance from a mortgage advisor or financial professional to understand your options and make informed decisions.
